name: io.github.amosgeva/portfoliodb
title: PortfolioDB
description: Read-only queries over your own append-only portfolio ledger on Postgres.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer {PORTFOLIODB_MCP_TOKEN} — the token from your .env, generated by `make init` (or `pdb.ps1 init` on Windows).

environmentVariables.name: PORTFOLIODB_MCP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Shared bearer token every MCP request must present. `make init` generates one, as does `pdb.ps1 init` on Windows.

environmentVariables.name: PORTFOLIODB_MCP_RO_USER
environmentVariables.description: The SELECT-only Postgres role this server connects as (normally `portfoliodb_ro`). Required: the server refuses to connect without it. `make ro-role` (or `pdb.ps1`/`python app/create_ro_role.py --generate`) creates the role and prints this line. Never give this server the application's read-write password.

environmentVariables.name: PORTFOLIODB_MCP_RO_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password for the SELECT-only role above, as printed by `make ro-role`.

environmentVariables.name: PORTFOLIODB_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Postgres host. This server reads your ledger, it does not host one. Inside the shipped docker-compose network this is `postgres`.

environmentVariables.name: PORTFOLIODB_MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated Host-header names to accept besides localhost/127.0.0.1/::1, e.g. `192.168.1.20,nas.lan` when other machines connect. Any other Host is refused (421). `*` disables the check.
